architecture.authorization_boundary: shared active-principal and WorkspaceService membership checks, independent of storage drivers
architecture.request_scope: headers select a tenant/workspace; they cannot grant access
architecture.privileged_paths: explicit master credential and trusted administration/projection workers

findings_fixed.issue: FORCE RLS does not constrain a superuser/BYPASSRLS runtime connection
findings_fixed.fix: scoped transactions assume edgequake_tenant_access, verify its attributes and install local context

findings_fixed.issue: membership verification depended on PostgreSQL and an opt-in flag
findings_fixed.fix: production authentication requires active membership through the selected WorkspaceService

findings_fixed.issue: workspace administrator could be treated as tenant administrator
findings_fixed.fix: tenant management requires a tenant-wide owner/admin membership

findings_fixed.issue: stale JWT/key owners could retain a disabled account or elevated role
findings_fixed.fix: reload durable owner status/lockout/role and cap granted privileges

findings_fixed.issue: nested Axum routes stripped prefixes used for authorization
Ollama compatibility queries omitted tenant/workspace scope
findings_fixed.fix: gate authentication and construct one shared scoped request for chat/generate, streaming and nonstreaming

findings_fixed.issue: malformed workspace scope could degrade to tenant-wide RLS
findings_fixed.fix: reject malformed and missing scoped requests before invoking storage

findings_fixed.issue: Qdrant point identifiers and deletes could collide across scopes
findings_fixed.fix: scope-derived physical UUIDs, mandatory payload/model filters and scoped deletes

findings_fixed.issue: Neo4j revision digest query had invalid UNION structure
findings_fixed.fix: independent scoped MATCH/RETURN branches with matching columns

findings_fixed.issue: long AGE namespaces aliased node/edge trigger functions
findings_fixed.fix: short schema-qualified functions and centralized trigger repair

findings_fixed.issue: ownerless break-glass key management returned persistence errors
findings_fixed.fix: require a user-account identifier before managing user keys

findings_fixed.issue: legacy RLS tests truncated shared document data or silently skipped required fixtures
findings_fixed.fix: unique UUID fixtures, required-service failures and positive owner reads

findings_fixed.issue: default workspace authorization could attach a tenant-wide RLS context; equivalent UUID casing produced different storage keys
findings_fixed.fix: canonicalize tenant/workspace before attaching the shared request and RLS scope

findings_fixed.issue: generic prepared ANN plans ignore workspace and nullable lineage bind selectivity
findings_fixed.fix: use transaction-local custom plans in the shared typed ANN session, retaining natural scan selection and exact score reordering

findings_fixed.issue: MCP workspace catalog exposed sibling workspace metadata and tenant-wide totals to workspace-only members
findings_fixed.fix: shared REST/MCP active-membership visibility policy, trusted principal and role, filtering before pagination

performance_change.mechanism: combine role attribute verification and local context setup; resolve workspace ownership once
performance_change.limits: local timings are affected by concurrent builds and Docker scheduling; no production SLA or controlled causal speedup claim
performance_change.typed_ann_plan_cache_mode: force_custom_plan (transaction local; confirmed reset to auto)
performance_change.tradeoff: paired measurements retain the selective relationship case where generic planning was faster; custom planning improves the broad measured workspaces, not every workload

limits: Full alternate SQLite/Qdrant/Neo4j HTTP deployment profiles remain certification-gated; adapter isolation and independent factory composition have separate E2E coverage.
Privileged control-plane and legacy maintenance operations retain base-pool access; 39 content tables plus AGE labels have the new restrictive policies, not every scope-bearing table.
PostgreSQL infrastructure remains required by the current API platform.
Source-query PREPARE coverage is not execution or performance proof for every query; dynamic SQL is explicitly unresolved in the catalog.
Index-plan assertions apply to the measured fixtures and cannot establish globally optimal production plans.
Existing pre-certification Qdrant points without scoped physical-revision metadata need re-projection before use.
Neo4j Community and shared Qdrant service credentials rely on scoped adapter ports; tenant end users do not receive direct database credentials.

design_changes.single_responsibility: request authorization, credential validation, RLS transaction setup and AGE trigger provisioning have separate focused modules
design_changes.dependency_inversion: authorization depends on WorkspaceService and IdentityStore ports; relational/vector/graph factories remain independent
design_changes.dry: REST, MCP and WebSockets share principal/scope validation; provider reads share bounded scoped ANN transactions; AGE trigger definitions have one implementation
design_changes.workspace_catalog: REST and both MCP aliases share WorkspaceService-based policy; no concrete-provider casts or duplicated visibility logic

fixture_repairs: typed ANN temporary tables enforce RLS under the same non-bypass role and use owned workspace records
authenticated MCP workspaces explicitly select mock providers, independent of developer credentials
pending visibility atomically holds both provider receipts and closes the serving fence; queries do not echo the secret sentinel
PostgreSQL-only test helpers and cases have feature guards; memory contracts remain enabled in default builds.

query_coverage.limits: PREPARE validates schema and parameter types; it does not prove execution or performance. Dynamic provider paths have selected E2E coverage, not complete source-to-runtime attribution.

typed_ann.limits: paired planning includes EXPLAIN overhead; custom planning is slower for the measured selective relationship case

graph_mutation_review.entity_updates: Exact node resolution verifies tenant/workspace and restamps scope after allowlisted fields.
graph_mutation_review.relationship_updates: Scoped relationship lookup and allowlisted fields preserve top-level scope; arbitrary metadata is nested.
